data.name: Musyaari
data.gender_notes: Musyaari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musyaari is derived from the Arabic word 'safar' which means 'to travel'. The name signifies a person who is on a spiritual journey, constantly seeking knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was known as 'Al-Mudhaffar' or 'The Traveler', emphasizing his mission to spread the message of Islam and guide humanity to the right path.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey of self-discovery and personal growth.
data.etymology: Musyaari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler, Journeyer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musyaari total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مسياري
in_arabic.meaning: المسياري يعني الذي يمشي في الطريق المستقيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: المسياري اسم مشتق من الفعل 'سار' و يعني الشخص الذي يمشي في الطريق المستقيم و الحق. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية و محمودة في الثقافة الإسلامية. و يرتبط هذا الاسم بالسير على نهج النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم و السلف الصالح.

in_urdu.name: مسیاری
in_urdu.meaning: مسیاری مطلب ہے جو سیدھے راستے پر چلتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مسیاری نام عربی زبان کے الفعل 'سار' سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو سیدھے راستے پر چلتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں مثبت اور قابل ستائش معانیを持つ माना جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم اور سلف صالح کے نقش قدم پر چلنے کی یاد دلاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: मुस्यारी
in_hindi.meaning: मुस्यारी का अर्थ है जो सीधे रास्ते पर चलता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुस्यारी नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'सार' से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो सीधे रास्ते पर चलता है। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सकारात्मक और प्रशंसनीय अर्थों वाला माना जाता है। यह नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم और सलफ صالح के नक्शे कदम पर चलने की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: مسیاري
in_pashto.meaning: مسیاري د معنی دا چې په سیده لاره روان وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مسیاري نوم د عربي ژبې د 'سار' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او معنی یې هغه څوک دی چې په سیده لاره روان وي. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې مثبت او ستایښتی معنا لري. دا نوم د رسول الله صلی الله علیه و آله وسلم او سلف صالح د طریقې پر چللو دلالت کوي.

in_english.name: Musyaari
in_english.meaning: Musyaari means one who walks on the straight path
in_english.long_meaning: The name Musyaari is derived from the Arabic verb 'sâr', which means to walk. It signifies a person who walks on the straight path, adhering to the righteous way of life. This name holds positive connotations in Islamic culture, symbolizing adherence to the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the righteous predecessors. The name Musyaari embodies spiritual guidance, moral integrity, and a commitment to following the true path.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah (The Beginning and The End) - Volume 10, Page 339-340 The name Musyaari carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Musyaari ibn Khalid was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He was among the ten who were given the title of 'The Ten Promised Paradise'. During the Battle of Tabuk, Musyaari promised the Prophet that if he were able to accompany the Prophet to Tabuk, he would face the enemy with great courage. When the Prophet learned that he could not join the campaign, Musyaari, in fulfillment of his promise, went to the battlefield and joined the army as a volunteer. He was martyred there.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham's Sirah Ibn Hisham - Volume 2, Page 425 The name Musyaari carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Musyaari ibn Khalid Al-Ansari was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He was a skilled archer. In the Battle of Uhud, Musyaari had a vision in which he saw the Prophet being attacked from behind by the enemy. He was so distressed that he left his position in the front lines and ran to the Prophet's side. He managed to draw the enemy's attention away from the Prophet, who was able to retreat safely. Musyaari was later martyred by the enemy.
